<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, there are two distinct carbon signals in the typical methyl region: one at ~58.7 ppm (likely a methoxy CH₃) and another at ~26.4 ppm (an aliphatic CH₃). No other methyl‑type signals are evident. Therefore the molecule contains two methyl groups.</thought>
